title: For agents intervention
motivation: Previous experiments decomposed individual properties such as audience labels, isolation, headings, representation, and compression. Those experiments repeatedly hit compliance ceilings. Phase 3 returns to the practical intervention itself: does adding a dedicated agent-oriented section to an existing documentation page help?
question: Given ordinary documentation that already contains the information needed to solve a task, does adding a concise agent-oriented summary of the important operational guidance improve task behavior?
independent_variable: presence of a For agents section

conditions.B: Exactly the same documentation plus a concise For agents section

system_prompt: Use the supplied documentation to complete the task.
main_design: 5 tasks x 2 conditions x 3 runs = 30 calls/model
smoke_design: 2 tasks x 2 conditions x 1 run = 4 calls/model
